result:
## Summary

Added slug-based URLs for posts:

- **`db/schema.ts`** / **`db/migrations/20260818043139_add_slug_to_posts/`**: added a `slug` (unique, not null) column to `posts`, with a hand-written migration that backfills existing rows with `post-<id>` before enforcing the NOT NULL/UNIQUE constraint (drizzle-kit's auto-generated migration would have failed on non-empty tables, since SQLite requires a default for that).
- **`app/Support/slug.ts`**: pure `slugify()` helper (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to single `-`, trimmed).
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: a `PostSlugObserver` (`creating` hook) derives the slug from the title and de-dupes with `-2`, `-3`, … suffixes; `slug` is marked `optionalOnCreate` since it's server-derived, never client-supplied. Updates never touch it, so slugs stay stable across title edits.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `show()` now accepts `:idOrSlug` — a purely numeric value is looked up by id and 301-redirected to `/posts/<slug>` (404 if unknown), anything else is looked up by slug (404 if unknown) and renders the page. `store()`/`update()` now redirect to the slug URL.
- **`routes/web.ts`**: `posts.show` route path changed to `/posts/:idOrSlug`; edit/update/destroy stay id-based.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`** / **`Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: added `slug` to the resource payload and a `PostShowParamSchema`.
- **`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`, `posts/Index.tsx`**: post links now point at the slug.
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`**: sample posts get slugs via `slugify()` (seeder writes raw rows, bypassing the model observer).
- **`tests/PostSlug.test.ts`** (new): covers slug generation/formatting, de-duplication, stability across edits, slug-based show (200/404), legacy id redirect (301) and 404, and that the slug field is present on index/home/search payloads.

`bun run typecheck`, `bunx guren check`, and `bun test` (13/13) all pass.
